summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 to ControlType and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member to ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the ESC ] 0 ; title BEL format entry and a Control.title(title) classmethod. rich/_windows_renderer.py dispatches SET_WINDOW_TITLE to term.set_title(title). rich/console.py adds set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, gated on is_terminal. CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added: test_set_window_title (skipped on win32) in tests/test_console.py, test_control_title in tests/test_control.py, and test_control_set_window_title (Windows-only module) in tests/test_windows_renderer.py. Not run: per instructions, no tests, Black, or installs were executed, so results are unverified. Nothing was committed.
